sloka: निरीक्ष्य स मुहूर्त्तं तु ददर्श भरतो गुरम्।उटजे राममासीनं जटामण्डलधारिणम् ॥ २.९९.२५॥
transliteration: nirīkṣya sa muhūrttaṁ tu dadarśa bharato guram।uṭaje rāmamāsīnaṁ jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇam ॥ 2.99.25॥

translations.english: Bharata looked around for a moment and saw his esteemed brother Rama seated in that thatched cottage wearing matted locks of hair.
